items.statement: Keep enough patient identification information on file, for patients in postmarketing reports, that FDA can identify each patient's name and address using it alone or together with the study investigator's records.
items.quote: The applicant shall maintain sufficient patient identification information to permit FDA, by using that information alone or along with records maintained by the investigator of a study, to identify the name and address of individual patients

not_applicable.text: Upon written request the agency may require that the applicant submit the reports
If an applicant fails to make reports required under this section, FDA may withdraw approval
